title: P0-COORD shard-config-coord: Define ShardConfig v2 and Runtime::new_with_journal signature before P2-14a/P2-17/P2-18 land
description: Coordination P0-COORD (new bead per black-hat FIND-R4). Black-hat review round 1 identified a Risk 4: 3 P2 beads (P2-14a storage-batch, P2-14b shard-coalesce, P2-17r submit-artifact, P2-18r snapshot-writer) all touch ShardConfig and/or Runtime::new_with_journal. If they land in any order without coordination, the ShardConfig schema and the Runtime constructor signature will churn (each bead adds a field, breaking the previous bead's work). The fix: land a coordination commit FIRST that defines ShardConfig v2 (with all 3 new fields: coalesce_window_us, snapshot_interval_steps, batched_atomicity) and the canonical Runtime::new_with_journal signature, with no production behavior change. After this bead lands, the 3 dependent beads can be claimed in parallel without type churn. Real source: crates/vb_runtime/src/shard/config.rs (ShardConfig — currently v1; we define v2), crates/vb_runtime/src/runtime/mod.rs (Runtime::new_with_journal — the canonical signature). The v2 schema: `pub struct ShardConfig { pub coalesce_window_us: u64, pub snapshot_interval_steps: u32, pub batched_atomicity: bool, ..v1_fields }`. The new Runtime::new_with_journal signature: `pub fn new_with_journal(journal: Arc<FjallJournal>, config: ShardConfig) -> Self`. Kani harness: prove ShardConfig v2 default is consistent with v1 default for the v1 fields. proptest: 100 random ShardConfig v2 instances produce valid Runtime instances.

THE SYSTEM SHALL define the canonical Runtime::new_with_journal signature that P2-14a, P2-14b, P2-17r, P2-18r all use
